# OpenResearchAssets · Agent navigation

> 中文权威说明：https://openresearchassets.github.io/for-agents/
> Low-token discovery: https://openresearchassets.github.io/catalog/manifest.json
> Canonical catalog: https://openresearchassets.github.io/catalog/index.json

OpenResearchAssets curates reusable research references, editable diagrams, workflows and research-quality guidance. It is Chinese-first with supporting English descriptions. Never assume a third-party figure or webpage screenshot is licensed for redistribution.

## Real-paper case with source-grounded evidence
- [RoboRender editorial study, bilingual](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/roborender.html)
- [Original paper project](https://robo-render.github.io/)
- [Author-reported per-task CSV](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/roborender-results.csv)
- [Source audit and limitations](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/roborender-provenance.md)
- [Editable method analysis SVG](https://openresearchassets.github.io/assets/examples/roborender-method.svg)
- [Editable evidence analysis SVG](https://openresearchassets.github.io/assets/examples/roborender-evidence.svg)

Author-reported, NOT independently replicated. Video renderer learned from real robot videos; zero-shot deployment describes the downstream policy. Case content is editorial analysis, not a second catalog source-of-truth.

## Complete worked examples (teaching scenarios, not empirical results)
- [Three connected worked examples](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples.html)
- [Method figure guide / 中文](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/method-figure.zh.md)
- [Method figure guide / English](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/method-figure.en.md)
- [Experiment design / 中文](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/experiment-design.zh.md)
- [Experiment design / English](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/experiment-design.en.md)
- [Project homepage / 中文](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/project-homepage.zh.md)
- [Project homepage / English](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/project-homepage.en.md)
- [Blank evidence register CSV](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/evidence-register.csv)
- [Runnable teaching HTML](https://openresearchassets.github.io/examples/sample-project.html)

These form an invented, self-contained teaching scenario. Never cite the diagrams as published robot research or infer measured improvements. For authoritative indexed asset metadata, use catalog/index.json instead.

## Read first
- [AI 使用指南 / Agent guide](https://openresearchassets.github.io/for-agents/)
- [Compact AI manifest (JSON)](https://openresearchassets.github.io/catalog/manifest.json)
- [Canonical catalog (JSON)](https://openresearchassets.github.io/catalog/index.json)
- [Interactive discovery](https://openresearchassets.github.io/#references)
- [Actionable workflows: literature](https://openresearchassets.github.io/workflows/literature-triage.md)
- [Actionable workflows: experiments](https://openresearchassets.github.io/workflows/experiment-planning.md)
- [Actionable workflows: writing](https://openresearchassets.github.io/workflows/paper-evidence-story.md)
- [Actionable workflows: release](https://openresearchassets.github.io/workflows/research-release.md)
- [Asset schema & provenance](https://openresearchassets.github.io/docs/ASSET_SCHEMA.md)
- [Rights policy](https://openresearchassets.github.io/docs/ASSET_POLICY.md)

Suggested sequence: read compact manifest → select by task/stage/domain/kind → load only relevant `entry` JSON files (relative to site root) → check applicability and rights → verify resulting work.
